funnel.title: The funnel: 388 backbones in, 20 designs out
funnel.subtitle: green = free (CPU, seconds), orange = GPU minutes, pink = the expensive verification round only the final twenty earn

generation.heading: Generation - 388 backbones over six waves
generation.sub: two generators (local Genie 3, hosted RFD4-Proteina NIM) conditioned on explicit hotspot sets, built against the 221-residue apical block of 11QC chain A

slices.label: C1 triage · RFD4 · 97
slices.legend: C1 RFD4-Proteina: 24-25 designs on each of the four apical patches E0/E1/E2/E12; 24/24 obey the named tip, E12's two-anchor patch the thinnest

slices.label: C1 triage · Genie 3 · 96
slices.legend: C1 Genie 3: 24 per patch, CA-only ProteinMPNN sequences, all 96 pass the geometry screen

slices.label: C2 batch-2 · E12 · 81
slices.legend: C2 batch-2: 49 RFD4 + 32 Genie 3, all on the surviving E12 anchors K344/K374 - the generator comparison

slices.label: C2 batch-3 · RFD4 · 48
slices.legend: C2 batch-3: 24 more E12 designs, plus 24 on the triple-cation set E3 {231,344,374} that the N251 glycan closed

slices.label: C2 wave-2 · hybrid + long · 42
slices.legend: C2 wave 2: 26 RFD4 + 16 RFdiffusion on the hybrid set H {R208,Y211,K344,K374} and a 110-140 aa length sweep

slices.label: C5 two-chain units · 24
slices.legend: C5: RFD4 asked for two designed chains that must hold the target and each other - the architecture probe

steps.title: Geometry and glycan screen
steps.text: min binder-target CA distance >= 3.0 A, >= 3 target CAs within 8 A, a designed hotspot within 12 A; then a footprint check against the N251 glycan (scripts/work/screen-gen-geometry.py)

steps.heading: All 96 triage designs pass; 11 designs excluded on the glycan
steps.sub: 9 of 24 E3 designs and 2 of 24 two-chain units were built into N251

steps.title: Unrestrained co-fold (Boltz-2)
steps.text: 5 samples per design against the full 639-residue protomer (peak 11.29 GiB of the 12.2 GB card, ~2.5 min per design), scored for ipSAE AND at-site contact AND clash (scripts/screen_folds_c4.py v2)

steps.heading: 0 clean at-site samples of 495
steps.sub: the native parvovirus binder floats 42-55 A away too: the read is fold-limited, recorded as cannot-decide, not as an epitope verdict

steps.title: Restrained co-fold with the engagement gate (Chai-1)
steps.text: pocket restraints on the designed anchors (8 A), 5 samples, seed 42, ~12 min per design; a read counts only when the worst anchor distance is <= 8 A and a binder residue sits at the site. Native reference 0.42-0.48; advance line 0.45

steps.heading: E12 advances: 8 of 24 vs E0's 5 of 24
steps.sub: E1/E2 re-screen 0 of 48 engaged; E3 1 of 15; C2 then clears 20 of 81, top 0.779

steps.title: The switch layer
steps.text: histidines placed 3.5-8.5 A from an anchor lysine NZ at rSASA >= 0.20, built on the parent's own MSA and restraints; gate 1 = binding within 0.10 of the parent; mechanism = PROPKA pKa bound vs free per engineered site

steps.heading: 21 of 29 variants keep their binding; 13 carry forward
steps.sub: engaging sites shift -0.5 to -2.8 pKa units; far-edge picks read flat (-0.05, -0.15); one site reads the wrong way (+0.48)

steps.title: Mouse cross-fold
steps.text: the identical restrained protocol against mouse TfR1 (AlphaFold Q62351), anchors mapped through the alignment to K346/K376 - never by a fixed offset, because the constructs carry an indel

steps.heading: 63 designs paired human vs mouse
steps.sub: two mouse-competent candidates; the three tightest human parents fall to 0.364 / 0.266 / 0.257

steps.title: The selector: floors, composite, diversity
steps.text: pLDDT >= 63, entropy >= 2.5 bits, top residue <= 45%, no homopolymer run of 6, at least one engaged sample; then total = 2.0*S + 1.5*X + 1.5*B + 1.0*E; then one design per 0.90-identity cluster (campaigns/c6-selection/scripts/select-top20.py)

steps.heading: 314 scored, 129 fail the floors, 39 held as near-neighbours
steps.sub: membership survived a from-scratch re-run with two adjacent ranks swapped

steps.title: The verification round
steps.text: unrestrained re-folds (no restraints at all), Boltz-2 ipSAE and pDockQ2, a seed-7 repeat on the top three, US-align novelty against the known-binder structures, the organizers' prescreen v0.5 (6,695 TfR1 references), the sequence-liability screen with repair variants folded on the full stack, and the dimer clash check

steps.heading: 11 of 20 engage unrestrained, 5 of them in every sample
steps.sub: 20/20 prescreen pass, 0 of 20 structural hits (max TM 0.49), zero N-glycosylation sequons, two repairs swapped in at no measured cost

final.heading: 20 designs submitted
final.sub: 60-108 aa, single_chain, 20 distinct backbones across 7 families; 5 at switch class S5, 4 reading mouse >= 0.60; 20/20 pass the prescreen

note.title: Loops that fed new variants back in.
note.text: No new backbones, only new sequences on proven ones: the C3 histidine retrofit (29 variants on 10 families), the switch-transfer round (10 variants on the three strongest switch-less parents, which put 53h and 13_48 into the twenty), the Proton-PottsMPNN pH-conditioned redesign arm (4 sane variants, closed at parity) and the liability repair round (5 variants, 2 swapped in, 3 held with their measured cost recorded).

molecular_figures.caption: The champion c3_e12rfd4_r4d5_d2 folded under the identical restrained protocol against the human apical domain (restrained ipTM 0.782, 5 of 5 samples engaged) and against the mouse receptor (0.688). Only the target changes between the panels: the same sequence, the same restraint set mapped through the alignment to mouse K346/K376, the same five samples.

One family, three sequences, one backbone: the campaign-2 parent e12rfd4_r5d1 (restrained 0.779) and its single- and double-histidine switch variants, each folded under the identical restraints against the human apical domain. The engineered histidines face the conserved anchor lysines K344 and K374; nothing else about the design changes between the panels.

Two histidines (H27 + H8, both anchors) - 0.779, submitted at rank 2
